Rooms & cheats

Jump anywhere; cheats are for skipping ahead while designing.

Layout: in EDIT mode click to select (inspector opens), drag to move — an object's interactive radius travels with it. Shift+arrows nudge · Del removes scenery · Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo. Saved locally per room.

Sound & music

Pick what plays where. AUTO = music box in the tea party & title, drone in the house. The top-bar SOUND button is the master switch. All tracks + per-room picks: EDIT bar → ♫ MUSIC.

End card

The TITLE screen is the friends' baked start-screen art (art/runtime/titleCard.png). These edit the ENDING card, live on its tab.

Characters & sprites

Uploads live in this browser only — instant experiments. To bake one in: save the PNG into art/runtime/ under that name and run npm run assets.

Palette

Locked to 5 purples + red (petals / tells / blood / candle only).
